name: Emami Paper Mills Ltd
description:
AboutIncorporated in 1981, Emami Paper Mills Ltd manufactures writing and printing paper, newsprint, and also packaging boards[1]Key PointsBusiness Overview:[1]Emami Paper is among the top 10 paper companies in India and a leading producerof packaging boards, with a capacity toproduce2 Lac MTPAusing recycled andvirgin fibre. Virgin fibre is one of the fastest-growing segments in the paper industry owingto the rising demand from fast-moving consumer goods, personal care, pharmaceuticals and e-commerce sectors.The company is also a leading player in the newsprint (NP) segment with a capacity to produce1.40 Lac MTPA. While the demand for writing and printing paper (WPP) segment has been stable over the past few years and is likely to grow at a low, single-digit growth rate over the medium term, Emami Paper benefits from being an established player in the segment, with a pan-India presence.Read MoreWebsiteBSENSE
